label: Coverage verdict: of 52 prescriptive rows in AGENTS.md sections 2/3/4/7, 33 have a direct expansion, 4 partial, 7 design-excluded by REPO RULES.md section 4, 8 true gaps

True gaps (8) cluster in section 3 process rows (two registers, plan before acting, research-first, self-checks, reason from actual data, fallbacks, verify with checks) plus section 2 Violation Recovery; sections 4 and 7 are near-saturated

Rule set carries net-new doctrine beyond expansion; delegation-and-orchestration.md is the largest net-new block (posture switch, brief carries evidence, one model one opinion, what comes back unverified)
Design exclusions in REPO RULES.md section 4 are honored: Gate 1/2/3, skill routing reference, completion verification rule, memory save rule have no expansion by design, not by omission

Set expands rows outside the RQ1 window too: evidence-and-proof section 10 expands AGENTS.md section 9 close-out, blast-radius section 3 expands section 5 git push policy, uncertainty section 2 expands section 9 never-fabricate
overengineering.md section 1 rung ladder has two loci: AGENTS.md L164 declares authoritative rungs in sk-code quality standards, rule file defines its own table
Gate 4 classification as design-excluded via workflow selection is a judgment call; the set has no text either way
scope-discipline.md section 5 deliberately refuses to restate PLAN-WORKFLOW LOCK; principled non-expansion of a section 1 hard blocker
All 7 rule files share anatomy: Fires-when trigger, rule statement, sections, SELF-CHECK; mirrors REPO RULES.md action matching
No rule file expands section 1 hard blockers (Four Laws, PLAN-WORKFLOW LOCK, Comment Hygiene, Halt Conditions), consistent with precedence ladder
